ops-bot: ALERT: cont-batch path p99 latency > 3s in us-west2 streaming cluster; automatic paging triggered. routing=streaming, model=rw-13b, region=us-west2 :rotating_light:

ops-bot: Triggers: p99 tokens/sec spike, streaming stalls observed, increased tail latency on continuous-batching workers. incident_id=inc-20260315-01

maria: acked. I'm oncall. jumping in — what's the impact?

leo: seeing a correlated rise in batch size variance + queue depth. mixed-seqlen jobs are inflating effective batch sizes and delaying short sequences. p95 ~ 450ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~ 1.8s -> 3.6s.

sara: logs show repeated KV cache eviction churn around same time (evict rate x3). KV hit ratio dropped 12%. streaming kernels show stalls waiting on prefetch threads.

aj: could be scheduler fairness + padding amplification. short requests are getting stranded behind a few giant sequences. also some clients sent long streaming contexts after a deploy ~13:42 UTC.

maria: first mitigations: 1) reduce max_batch_size from 256 -> 128 for streaming pool; 2) enable preemptive_shed for mixedlen queues; 3) route critical customers to spare pool. I'll run the flag changes now.

maria: commands I'm running (kubectl on private cluster):
```bash
# bump down streaming batch size config
kubectl -n inference patch configmap cont-batch-config -p '{"data":{"max_stream_batch": "128"}}'
# enable preemptive shed
kubectl -n inference patch configmap cont-batch-config -p '{"data":{"preemptive_shed": "true"}}'
```

leo: +1 on the batch size tweak. also flip seqlen-aware-routing to true (will keep long sequences on dedicated lanes).

sara: paging note — we should suspend KV compaction job temporarily; it's competing for IO with the streaming workers.

maria: done: max_stream_batch=128, preemptive_shed=true. seqlen-aware-routing toggled on. KV compaction paused (job-id=kv-compact-20260315). Observing metrics: within 60s p95 down to ~600ms, p99 trending to ~1.5s.

ops-bot: update: mitigation actions applied by @maria at 2026-03-15T13:55:10Z. Monitoring.

aj: initial customer impact check: two customers reported degraded streaming playback in the past 6 min. error rates for streaming endpoints up 0.7% overall; latency-sensitive customers see ~5% tail failures.

sara: putting together which customers are affected: cust-A (ml-playback), cust-C (docsummarize). Both in us-west2.

maria: reaching out to product for coordinated notify. @product-notify-bot can you draft P1 status? We'll wait for customer impact confirmation before public comms.

product-notify-bot: draft ready. Suggested blurb:
> We experienced elevated latency for streaming responses in us-west2 affecting some customers. Engineers applied live mitigations (batch size limit, seqlen routing, KV compaction pause) and are monitoring. We will follow up with timeline and root cause analysis.

leo: ongoing observations: a small worker subset (nodepool-pool-3) still shows high queueing — looks like a hotpath for long sequences. I'm moving that pool into drain and shifting routing to spare-pool-1.

sara: note — draining will drop connections briefly for some in-flight streams; prefer redirect rather than drain for now. Use soft-redirect patch I'm pushing.

maria: applied soft-redirect for nodepool-pool-3 -> spare-pool-1. No disconnects observed in the first 2 min. p99 improving to ~1.1s.

aj: can we get a quick metric snapshot for the next 15 min and capture a sample trace for a stalled stream? need trace id for RCA.

leo: capturing trace trace=tr-20260315-0055, sampling 10 matches, forwarding to /shared/investigations/contbatch-20260315.

ops-bot: NOTE: paging escalation threshold cleared — system p99 < 1.2s for 5 consecutive intervals. No longer auto-escalating.

maria: handoff to next oncall @leo in 20m. summary for handoff:
- Root symptom: cont-batch streaming p99 spike due to mixed sequence-length amplification + KV eviction churn following customer long-context deploy.
- Action taken: reduced max_stream_batch to 128; enabled preemptive_shed; turned on seqlen-aware-routing; paused KV compaction; soft-redirected hot nodepool to spare pool.
- Impact: reduced p99 from ~3.6s -> ~1.1s. customer-facing errors trimmed from peak ~5% -> ~1%.
- Next steps for next shift: 1) verify KV hit ratio stabilizes and compaction backlog cleared; 2) rollout seqlen-aware-routing cluster-wide after smoke tests; 3) schedule targeted model quantization tests for long-seq workloads to reduce per-token latency; 4) follow up RCA with traces + scheduler logs.

leo: taking handoff. I'll stay on for the next 2 hours. I'll run a controlled rollback of the deploy that introduced the long contexts if we see a re-spike.

sara: I'll lead RCA and collate traces + eviction metrics. planning a postmortem doc after stabilization.

maria: posting brief customer note now to affected accounts and marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:

product-notify-bot: customer messages queued for cust-A and cust-C. Suggest follow-up call if they report persistent degradation.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, monitored, incident state -> mitigated. incident_id=inc-20260315-01. Close when RCA doc linked.

leo: closing loop if no regressions over next 60 mins. tagging for postmortem: @sara (lead), @aj (scheduler), @maria (actions).

sara: adding checklist for RCA: traces, scheduler fairness metrics, batch size histograms, KV eviction timeline, deploy diff.

maria: thanks team. leaving short notes in handoff doc.

leo: ack.
